name: roblox-studio
description: Inspect, build, repair, validate, and playtest Roblox Studio maps and Luau through a local MCP bridge.

defaultPrompt: Build a playable Roblox obby in Studio.
Create a cabin with working doors and a balcony.
Inspect this generated map and repair its geometry.
